setup.command:
cat <<'EOS' >/tmp/setup_lz.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# F1 repo with hunks
rm -rf /tmp/lz_f1 /tmp/lz_f2 /tmp/lz_f3 /tmp/lz_f4
mkdir -p /tmp/lz_f1 && cd /tmp/lz_f1 && git init -q && git config user.email "a@a.com" && git config user.name "a" && echo -e "line1\nline2\nline3\nline4" > file.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "init" && echo -e "line1\nchanged2\nline3\nchanged4" > file.txt
# F2 repo for rebase
mkdir -p /tmp/lz_f2 && cd /tmp/lz_f2 && git init -q && git config user.email "a@a.com" && git config user.name "a" && echo "a" > f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c1" && echo "b" >> f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c2"
# F3 repo for cherry-pick
mkdir -p /tmp/lz_f3 && cd /tmp/lz_f3 && git init -q && git config user.email "a@a.com" && git config user.name "a" && echo "a" > f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c1" && git checkout -qb feature && echo "feature" > feat.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "feat" && git checkout -q master
# F4 repo for bisect
mkdir -p /tmp/lz_f4 && cd /tmp/lz_f4 && git init -q && git config user.email "a@a.com" && git config user.name "a" && echo "a" > f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c1" && echo "b" >> f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c2" && echo "c" >> f.txt && git add . && git commit -qm "c3" && git bisect start >&/dev/null && git bisect bad HEAD >&/dev/null; git bisect good HEAD~2 >&/dev/null || true
echo "setup done"
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/setup_lz.sh
/tmp/setup_lz.sh
